problem.title: Smart homes shouldn't mean breaking walls.
problem.body: Most smart-home solutions need new switchboards or fresh wiring. That is expensive, messy and slow. DIY modules sold online leave you to figure out the wiring yourself. Homeasy takes a simpler path.

options.title: New smart switchboards
points: Replaces the switches and design you chose

options.title: DIY online modules
points: No one to call when it stops working

how.title: How Homeasy works
how.sub: The smart part hides behind your switch.

steps.title: We open your switchbox
steps.body: Our electrician checks the wiring behind your existing switches.

steps.title: We fit a Homeasy module
steps.body: A compact smart module goes inside the box, connected to your switches.

steps.title: We close it up
steps.body: Your switchboard looks the same as before. Your switches work by hand as before.

steps.title: You control from the app
steps.body: Lights, fans, geyser and AC from your phone, on schedules or with scenes.

founder.quote: For over 13 years I've worked in interior design, automation and smart-home integration. Most families want a smarter home. They just don't want broken walls or new switchboards. Homeasy makes that possible, with the switches you already have.

faq.q: Do I need to change my switches?
faq.a: No. Homeasy modules fit inside your existing switchbox, behind the switches you already have.
Not in most homes. Our free survey checks your wiring first. If something needs a small fix, we tell you before you pay.
Yes. Your switches work by hand as before, even if the internet is down.
It depends on the number of rooms and switchboards. We give you a time estimate with your quote.

faq.q: What if the internet is down?
faq.a: Your switches always work. Control from the app needs Wi-Fi and internet.
We survey homes across Bihar. Use the pincode checker on this page, or send us a WhatsApp message.
